verdict: Continuous white-stage explainer: no hard cuts for 48 s, all beats dissolve or slide on the same field (sheet_1, 3, 5).
Blue keyword inside black headlines is the single accent device; the only saturated blue field is reserved for the Select Model dialog.
UI is abstracted: search pill, dialog card and icon diagrams stand in for screenshots; not a walkthrough.
Pacing is steady, one idea per 1.5-3 s with no flashes; the film ends with a 234-frame studio outro that is not part of the product story.

Useful lessons: isolated dialog with glow on a blue field, stat capsule with concentric ellipses, question-pill marquee, ghosted echo headline; avoid the missing hard cuts, a 30 s demo needs clearer beat boundaries.
